column7: A federated OIDC JWT's positive auth-cache entry is capped at the token's own exp (min(TTL, exp-now)) and never created for a token expired, within 5s of expiry, or reporting no exp; before, an expired token kept authenticating from the cache for up to validTokenTTL. Also TestOIDCCache_ExpInsideTTL_EntryEndsAtExp, TestOIDCCache_AtExp_EntryIsMiss, TestOIDCCache_ExpBeyondTTL_CachedForTTL, TestOIDCCache_JustOutsideSkew_Cached (same file).
